name: Farm Ricochet
storyline:
For generations, families have cultivated the peaceful grounds of Ricochet Farm, unaware of the ancient relic buried beneath their soil: the Ricochet Heart, a sacred seal that nourishes the land and keeps the boundaries between dimensions closed.

The calm is broken when the sky tears open, heralding the arrival of demonic forces loyal to Malgrath, King of the Rift. Intending to corrupt the Ricochet Heart, Malgrath plans to shatter the seal and turn the ancestral farmland into a permanent gateway for his dark empire, threatening the crops and homes with escalating waves of invading monsters.

Refusing to flee and abandon their family legacy, the farmers reactivate the old mill and light the beacon to summon legendary aid. Answering the signal, the Heroes' Legion arrives to take up arms, determined to hold the line, defend every inch of the land, and prevent the seal from falling into Malgrath's grasp.
summary: Farm Ricochet is a browser-based idle action RPG featuring strategic combat, hero progression, and resource gathering. Players assemble squads of up to five heroes to explore stages, complete objectives, gather resources, and battle increasingly challenging monsters. The game features skill progression, build customization, permanent talent trees, and an in-game marketplace for trading heroes. Built on blockchain technology, Farm Ricochet integrates Web3 assets and player-driven trading into its gameplay experience.
